title: Concept: Build suppression note in a response
description: A comment that records suppressed findings or bypassed checks in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The note says which check was disabled and why, which is a pointer at the one place the team already knows is weak.
applicability: Deployments that render a comment that records suppressed findings or bypassed checks into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The note says which check was disabled and why, which is a pointer at the one place the team already knows is weak.
